gloss: lecture notes; record of a lecture; transcript

definitions.gloss: written record of a lecture; lecture notes
definitions.explanation: A written or printed record of the content of a lecture or course, whether taken down by a student or published. Often compiled into booklets or course materials.

examples.japanese: {講義録|こうぎろく}を{読|よ}む。
{欠席|けっせき}した{学生|がくせい}に{講義録|こうぎろく}を{渡|わた}した。
examples.english: I gave the lecture notes to the student who was absent.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{教授|きょうじゅ}の{講義録|こうぎろく}が{一冊|いっさつ}の{本|ほん}にまとめられた。
examples.english: A famous professor's lectures were compiled into a single book.

notes:
Refers to the record itself, which may be handwritten notes, a transcript, or a published volume.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講義録|こうぎろく}を{取|と}る: to take lecture notes
- {講義録|こうぎろく}をまとめる: to compile lecture notes
- {講義録|こうぎろく}を{配|くば}る: to hand out lecture notes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {議事録|ぎじろく}: meeting minutes — the record of a meeting rather than a lecture
- {講義|こうぎ}: lecture — the spoken lecture itself, not its written record
